kb.Q01: On the Business plan, the first-response target for a High priority case is 4 hours [KA-0002].
kb.Q02: Because the workspace enforces SSO. When SSO is required, Lumora does not send password reset emails, since the password is managed by the identity provider [KA-0004]. The user should sign in with **Continue with SSO** and reset their password through their company IdP [KA-0004].
kb.Q03: No, that's not a bug. It means the workspace admin has set a strict sign-in policy: 3 failed attempts and a 24-hour lockout [KA-0005]. On Business and Enterprise, admins can set failed attempts from 3 to 10 and lockout from 15 minutes to 24 hours [KA-0005]. Explain that their own admin controls this, and that the admin can unlock the account right away: **Settings > Members**, select the user, then **⋯ > Unlock account**; the user can sign in immediately [KA-0005]. Support agents can also unlock the user from the Support Console after confirming the request with a workspace Admin [KA-0005].
kb.Q04:
The most likely cause is the phone's clock: Lumora uses time-based codes (TOTP, 30-second window), and if the phone's clock is more than about 60 seconds off, every code fails [KA-0006]. To fix it [KA-0006]:
1. Turn on automatic date and time on the phone (iOS: **Settings > General > Date & Time > Set Automatically**; Android: **Settings > System > Date & time > Set time automatically**). Google Authenticator on Android also has **⋮ > Settings > Time correction for codes > Sync now**.
2. Delete any old *Lumora* entries in the authenticator app.
3. In Lumora, cancel the setup dialog and start again at **Profile > Security > Two-factor authentication**, scanning the new QR code.
4. Enter the code that is currently showing.
kb.Q05: The allowed clock skew is 3 minutes [KA-0007]. `Assertion expired` means the IdP server's clock is off, so fix NTP on the IdP [KA-0007].
kb.Q06:
Not yet. This is an open known issue, engineering ticket ENG-4471, with a fix planned for release 2026.11.1 [KA-0008]. It has two causes: if the SAML connection has no Single Logout URL, Lumora never hears about the IdP logout, and even with Single Logout the web app's offline cache isn't cleared on logout [KA-0008]. Workarounds [KA-0008]:
- Configure Single Logout in both the IdP and Lumora (**Settings > Security > Single sign-on > Edit > Single Logout URL**), which ends the server-side session.
- Shorten **Settings > Security > Session lifetime** (down to 1 hour).
- On shared devices, turn on **Settings > Security > Disable offline cache**.
- Have users also sign out with **Profile > Sign out** in Lumora.
Link the case to ENG-4471 so the customer is notified when the fix ships [KA-0008].
kb.Q07: Check their seat type first. Seat type takes priority over role: a user on a Viewer seat is read-only even if their role says Admin [KA-0009]. In **Settings > Members**, find the user; if **Seat** says *Viewer*, change it to *Full*, which needs a free paid seat [KA-0009].
kb.Q08: Because the workspace has no seats left. When every paid seat is in use, invites wait in *Pending — awaiting seat* and no email is sent [KA-0010]. Add seats or free one up [KA-0010].
kb.Q09:
- **Deactivate** frees the seat and keeps everything the user created assigned to them. You can reverse it [KA-0011].
- **Remove** frees the seat and moves their open tasks to the person you choose. You can't reverse it [KA-0011].
kb.Q10: No. A pending charge that appears when a card is added or updated, and isn't on an invoice, is most likely a card **authorization hold**; it disappears within 3–7 business days [KA-0012]. Explain that it's a hold, not a charge, so there is nothing to refund [KA-0012].
kb.Q11:
Yes. Agents can refund true duplicates without approval, whatever the amount; the rule that refunds over $500 need a Billing Lead's approval applies to other refunds [KA-0012]. To refund it [KA-0012]:
1. In the Billing Console, open the duplicate **payment** (not the invoice).
2. Click **Refund > Full**, reason *Duplicate*.
3. Add a case comment with the refund ID.
The refund reaches the card in 5–10 business days, depending on the bank [KA-0012].
kb.Q12: No. The invoice ending `-V` is the voided original, and the one with the same base number ending `-R1` is its revision; only the revised invoice is charged [KA-0013]. Lumora creates a revision when billing details change after the invoice is issued, such as a new billing address, a VAT/tax ID or a PO number [KA-0013]. For a clean record, turn on **Settings > Billing > Hide voided invoices**, or use **Export statement** for a CSV with only valid invoices and credit notes [KA-0013].
kb.Q13: At 20 days they're past the 14-day grace period, so the workspace is **read-only** for everyone except Owners, who can still reach billing [KA-0015]. To restore access, an Owner updates the payment method under **Settings > Billing > Payment method** and clicks **Retry payment**; access comes back within a minute of a successful charge [KA-0015]. If nothing is done, the workspace is suspended after day 60 [KA-0015].
kb.Q14: Yes, it's a known gap: if storage goes from below 80% to 100% in one day, for example after a large bulk import, only the 100% message appears. A daily check that catches this is planned for 2026.11 [KA-0016]. At 100%, new uploads and new file versions are blocked, but viewing and downloading existing files keeps working [KA-0016]. To free space: empty the trash, keep fewer file versions (**Settings > Files > Version history**) and use **Usage > Storage > Largest files**; to add capacity, upgrade or buy 100 GB storage packs [KA-0016].
kb.Q15:
On Business the browser (web) upload limit is 250 MB [KA-0017][KA-0001]. Support can't raise it, because it's tied to the plan, but there are options [KA-0017]:
- **Use the API** for resumable uploads, up to 1 GB on Business (`POST /v2/files/uploads`, in 8 MB chunks).
- **Link instead of uploading** with **Attach > From cloud storage** (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box); linked files don't count against storage or the size limit.
- **Upgrade** to Enterprise (2 GB).
- **Compress or split** the file.
kb.Q16: The Team limit of 100 requests per minute (burst 20) is counted per workspace and shared by every API token and installed integration in it, so other apps such as the Salesforce connector, Zapier-style tools or a BI connector use the same allowance [KA-0018]. Search endpoints (`/v2/search`) also have a separate limit of 30 per minute [KA-0018]. Check **Settings > API > Usage**, which shows requests per token and per integration for the last 7 days; usually one integration is using most of the allowance [KA-0018]. Honor `Retry-After` with exponential backoff, and use webhooks, batch endpoints and `?fields=` to cut requests [KA-0018].
kb.Q17: Fix the endpoint, then click **Re-enable** and choose **Replay failed events**, which resends events from the last 72 hours [KA-0019]. (An endpoint is disabled after 24 hours of failed deliveries [KA-0019].)
kb.Q18: The v1 documentation was retired on 2026-08-01, when the developer site moved to a new platform. Old `/docs/api/...` links should redirect, but deep links to sections (with `#anchor`) don't; this is known issue DOC-311 [KA-0020]. Workaround: replace `/docs/api/` with `/v2/reference/` in the URL, or search the developer site [KA-0020]. Report broken links by logging the page URL and the link against DOC-311 [KA-0020].
kb.Q19: Exports over 50,000 rows run in the background, but older browser bookmarks still trigger the immediate download, which returns an empty file [KA-0021]. Ask the user to choose **Export > CSV (email me when ready)**; they'll get a download link valid for 7 days (maximum 1,000,000 rows per export) [KA-0021].
kb.Q20:
Treat it as a possible data exposure and set the priority to at least **High** [KA-0022]. A scheduled export received on 2026-09-10 is before the fix (2026.09.2, released 2026-09-16), so it matches known issue ENG-4388 (affected releases 2026.08.1 to 2026.09.1, scheduled exports only) [KA-0022]. Then [KA-0022]:
1. Ask for the export file name, the report or schedule name and the date received. Don't ask them to attach the file.
2. Escalate to the **Security & Privacy** queue; they decide whether the customer must be formally notified under the DPA.
3. Recommend the customer delete any copies, review the schedule's recipients, and check who holds **Export sensitive data** under **Settings > Roles**.
kb.Q21: Yes, as a beta. Cloud storage destinations (Amazon S3, Google Drive, SharePoint) are available on Business and above, in beta since 2026.10.1 [KA-0024]. An Owner turns it on under **Settings > Labs > Scheduled exports to cloud storage**; an S3 destination needs an integration connection with the bucket and an IAM role ARN, and files are named `<report>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.<ext>` [KA-0024]. If the customer asked for this as a feature request, tell them about the beta, link the case to FR-118 and close it as **Resolved – Available in beta** [KA-0024].
kb.Q22: This matches a known defect, fixed in 2026.08.2: schedules created before that release saved the timezone as UTC whatever was chosen, so the schedule shows the right timezone but runs in UTC [KA-0025]. **Fix:** edit the schedule, change any setting and change it back, then **Save**; saving rewrites the stored timezone [KA-0025].
kb.Q23: The most common cause is a fixed date range: the widget's filter is set to absolute dates (for example *1 Jul – 31 Jul*) instead of a relative range [KA-0026]. Edit the widget, go to **Filters > Date**, and choose a relative option such as **This month** or **Last 30 days** [KA-0026]. If that isn't it, check whether the source report is a paused snapshot (**Last refreshed**), whether a data connector stopped syncing, refresh the widget's cache (**⋯ > Refresh**), and check **Edit widget > Source** in case it points to the wrong report [KA-0026].
kb.Q24:
Table views load up to 100,000 rows into the browser by default, and above that, filtering in the browser uses a lot of memory and CPU [KA-0028]. The main fix is to turn on server-side filtering: in the view, go to **View settings > Performance > Filter on server**, so filters run on Lumora's servers and only 500 rows are loaded at a time [KA-0028]. Also [KA-0028]:
- Filter on indexed fields (Status, Assignee, dates, Project, or custom fields marked **Indexed**).
- Use saved views with the filters already set.
- Hide formula columns you don't need, and archive old rows.
If it continues with server-side filtering on, collect a HAR file and a browser performance profile and escalate to Frontend Engineering [KA-0028].
kb.Q25: A regular schedule points to the most common cause: the Salesforce **Refresh Token Policy**. If it's set to "Expire refresh token after X hours", the connector disconnects on that schedule [KA-0031]. In Salesforce Setup, go to **Connected Apps OAuth Usage > Lumora Workspace > Manage > Edit Policies** and set **Refresh Token Policy** to *Refresh token is valid until revoked* [KA-0031]. Then reconnect under **Settings > Integrations > Salesforce > Reconnect**, signed in as the integration user; field mappings are kept [KA-0031].
kb.Q26: It means the form never reaches the payment step. Check the payment field's conditional logic [KA-0033].
kb.Q27:
A custom field can't be deleted while anything still uses it: automation rules, report filters/columns or dashboard widgets, form questions, formula fields, integration field mappings or required-field rules [KA-0035]. It looks like nothing happens because of a known UI defect (ENG-4502): the message listing those references sometimes closes straight away; a fix is due in 2026.11.1 [KA-0035]. To fix it [KA-0035]:
1. In **Settings > Fields**, open the field and go to the **Usage** tab, which lists every reference.
2. Remove or change each reference.
3. Click **Delete** again.
If it's used in many places, choose **Archive field** instead [KA-0035].
kb.Q28: 200 runs: a scheduled rule that updates 200 tasks counts as one run per task [KA-0036].
kb.Q29: "Daily" includes weekends, so this is expected. In the task, go to **Repeat** and choose **Every weekday (Mon–Fri)** instead of **Daily** [KA-0037]. For a different working week, an Admin sets **Settings > Workspace > Working days**, then choose **Repeat > Every working day** [KA-0037]. To remove the weekend tasks already created, filter the project by **Created by: Recurrence** and **Due date: is weekend**, select them and delete them [KA-0037].
kb.Q30: No. The 2.3.1 launch crash was resolved in iOS 2.3.2, so if a user still reports a crash on launch with 2.3.2 or later, that article doesn't apply [KA-0040]. Ask for the app version, the iOS version and the crash log (**Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data**, entries starting with `Lumora`), then escalate to Mobile Engineering [KA-0040].
kb.Q31:
This is an open known issue, ticket FE-1290, with a fix planned for release 2026.11.2 [KA-0041]. Until then, the workarounds are [KA-0041]:
- Use the native *Lumora for iPad* app (recommended).
- In Safari, tap **aA > Request Desktop Website**.
- Collapse the sidebar with the **«** button.
- Use portrait orientation.
Don't close the case: link it to FE-1290 so the customer is notified when the fix ships, and set the status to **Pending Release**, not Closed [KA-0041].
kb.Q32: Not from backup: on Business, backups are kept for 30 days, so 45 days ago is outside the backup window [KA-0042]. However, field changes on a task can be reverted with no time limit, from the task's **Activity** tab, then **Revert** [KA-0042], so the bulk edit can still be undone that way.
kb.Q33: No. Audit log entries can't be edited or deleted, including by Owners [KA-0043]. Enterprise keeps them for 7 years, and they can also be streamed out to a SIEM [KA-0043].
kb.Q34: No. Only subdomains are supported as custom domains, not apex domains like `example.com` [KA-0044]. Use a subdomain such as `work.example.com`: enter it under **Settings > Workspace > Custom domain** and create a CNAME record `work.example.com → custom.lumora.example` [KA-0044].
kb.Q35: Not yet. The app is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), French, German, Japanese and Dutch; Italian and Polish are planned for the first half of 2027 (feature request FR-077) [KA-0045]. Users choose their language under **Profile > Preferences > Language** [KA-0045].
